🌱 *mPowerClub — Youth Facilitator Simulation*

This flow simulates the digital journey of a Youth Facilitator (YF) in Sauramandala's CMYC programme.

👤 *Who is a Youth Facilitator?*
A YF is a trained community youth worker who:
• Forms and runs mPowerClubs in their community
• Recruits young people (14–25 yrs) as club members
• Plans and conducts activities (discussions, games, skills)
• Reports to a Centre Coordinator (CC)

🎭 *You are playing the role of a YF.*
Lines marked [REAL] show what happens in live deployment.

Reply anything to begin 👇

Let's set up your YF profile.

What is your full name?

Which CMYC centre are you attached to?

(Type the name, e.g. "Mawlai Centre" or "Nongthymmai Centre")

[REAL] In deployment, your Centre Coordinator would already have registered the centre and invited you as a YF before you onboard.

✅ *YF Profile saved!*

👤 *Name:* @results.yf_name
🏢 *Centre:* @results.centre_input
🎯 *Role:* Youth Facilitator

You are now registered as an mPowerClub Youth Facilitator.

🚀 Starting your orientation journey...

[SIMULATION] You will receive tips and prompts every 10 minutes. Reply to any message to move faster, or just wait.

🎓 *Welcome to your YF Orientation!*

Here is what you can do as a Youth Facilitator on WhatsApp:

📋 *Your keywords (use anytime):*
• *addmember* — Register a new club member
• *attendance* — Record session attendance
• *report* — Submit an activity report

You will also receive:
📌 Facilitation tips
📚 Activity ideas and session plans
📊 Weekly report prompts
🗓 Session reminders from your CC

[REAL] In live deployment you would also receive calls to action from your Centre Coordinator and see your club's progress on a dashboard.

⏳ First tip in 10 minutes... (or reply anything to receive it now)

💡 *Tip #1 — The mPowerClub Way*

mPowerClubs are youth-led spaces. Your job as YF is to:

1️⃣ *Invite, not recruit* — Let youth choose to join
2️⃣ *Facilitate, not teach* — Ask questions, don't lecture
3️⃣ *Document, don't just do* — Every session is a data point

🏆 A strong mPowerClub has:
• 8–15 regular members
• Weekly or bi-weekly meetings
• At least one activity per session
• A safe, consistent meeting space

[REAL] This tip would reach you 2 days after onboarding. You will get 8 tips over 4 weeks.

⏳ Next: Setting up your first club... (10 min or reply to continue)

🏗️ *Let's set up your first mPowerClub!*

[REAL] Club formation means bringing 8–15 young people together from your community, holding a first meeting, and choosing a name together.

[SIMULATION] We will create your club here to show how it works in the system.

*What will you name your club?*
(e.g. "Rising Stars Club", "Green Valley Youth", "New Horizon Club")

Great name! 👏

*Which community or area is this club based in?*
(e.g. "Mawphlang village", "Upper Shillong ward 5", "Nongkynmaw")

✅ *Club Registered!*

🏆 *Club Name:* @results.club_name
📍 *Area:* @results.club_area_input
👤 *YF:* @contact.fields.full_name.value

[REAL] In live deployment, this club would appear on your Centre Coordinator's dashboard. You would receive a club ID to use in all reports.

⏳ Tip #2 coming in 10 minutes... (or reply to continue)

💡 *Tip #2 — Planning Your First Session*

A great first session:

🕐 *Duration:* 60–90 minutes
👥 *Opening:* Names game / icebreaker (15 min)
🗣️ *Main:* Discussion or activity (30–40 min)
📋 *Closing:* Reflections + next meeting date (10 min)

*3 things to prepare:*
1. A simple icebreaker game
2. One open discussion question
3. A notebook to record attendance

[REAL] You would receive a full session plan from your CC 3 days before your first session.

⏳ Next: Adding a club member... (10 min or reply to continue)

👥 *Adding a Club Member*

[REAL] In live deployment you share the bot number with youth in your community. They send *smjoin* and register as Club Members — selecting CMYC → Youth Member. They join your club's WhatsApp group automatically.

[SIMULATION] We will collect one member's details here to show how it works.

*Member's full name?*
*How old are they?* (e.g. "17")

*Do they have WhatsApp?*

1 - Yes
2 - No

[REAL] If yes, they will be invited to message the bot and register directly. If no, the YF submits their data.

✅ *Member noted!*

*Name:* @results.member_name_sim
*Age:* @results.member_age_sim
*WhatsApp:* @results.member_whatsapp

[REAL] In deployment this would:
• Register them as a contact in the system
• Add them to your club's group
• Send them a welcome message
• Track their attendance over time

⏳ Attendance recording in 10 minutes... (or reply to continue)

📋 *Session Attendance*

[SIMULATION] Imagine you just ran your first mPowerClub session!

[REAL] After every session, you record attendance here. Your CC sees this in real time and follows up if attendance is low or a member is absent repeatedly.

*How many youth attended your (simulated) first session?*
(Type a number, e.g. "12")

✅ *Attendance recorded: @results.attendance_count_sim youth*

Great work running your first session! 🎉

[REAL] This data feeds into Sauramandala's monitoring system. Clubs with consistent attendance receive more resources and facilitator support.

⏳ Activity report in 10 minutes... (or reply to continue)

📊 *Activity Report*

[REAL] After each session you submit a short report. This helps Sauramandala track what activities work best across all clubs.

*What activity did you do in this session?*

1 - Icebreaker / introductions
2 - Group discussion
3 - Creative (art, drama, music)
4 - Outdoor / physical
5 - Community service / action

*How did the session go?*

1 - 😰 Very challenging
2 - 😕 Struggled a bit
3 - 😐 It was okay
4 - 😊 Went well
5 - 🌟 Excellent!

*What was one thing that worked well?*

(Type freely — this goes directly to the programme team)
*What was one challenge or difficulty you faced?*
Please reply 1 (Yes) or 2 (No).

🎉 *Simulation Complete!*

You have experienced the full mPowerClub YF journey:

✅ Onboarded as Youth Facilitator
✅ Received orientation tips
✅ Set up club: @contact.fields.club_name.value
✅ Added a club member (simulated)
✅ Recorded attendance
✅ Submitted activity report

📋 *Your keywords — use anytime:*
• *addmember* — Add a new member
• *attendance* — Record a session
• *report* — Submit activity report

[REAL] In live deployment you would also:
📅 Receive session reminders from your CC
📚 Get 8 tips over 4 weeks
📊 Submit weekly summary reports
🏆 Track your club's growth over time

Welcome to mPowerClub, @contact.fields.full_name.value! 🌱

Sauramandala CMYC Programme

👥 *Register a Club Member*

[REAL] In live deployment, you share the bot number with youth and they register themselves. This flow lets you register a member on their behalf — for example if they don't have WhatsApp.

[SIMULATION] Registering a member for your club: @contact.fields.club_name.value

*Member's full name?*
*Member's age?* (e.g. "16")

*Member's gender?*

1 - Female
2 - Male
3 - Prefer not to say

*Do they have WhatsApp?*

1 - Yes (they can message the bot directly)
2 - No (YF registers on their behalf)
Please reply 1 (Yes) or 2 (No).

✅ *Member Registered!*

👤 *Name:* @results.member_name
🎂 *Age:* @results.member_age
♀️ *Gender:* @results.member_gender
📱 *WhatsApp:* @results.member_has_whatsapp
🏆 *Club:* @contact.fields.club_name.value

[REAL] This member is now added to your club record. If they have WhatsApp, they will receive a welcome message and can access the programme independently.

Send *addmember* to register another member.

📋 *Record Session Attendance*

Club: @contact.fields.club_name.value
YF: @contact.fields.full_name.value

[REAL] This goes to your Centre Coordinator and Sauramandala's monitoring dashboard in real time.

*Which session is this?*
(e.g. "Session 1", "Week 3 meeting", "28 June session")

*How many youth were present?*
(Type a number)

*Any notable moments from this session?*

(e.g. "New member joined", "Discussion got heated but resolved well", or type *skip* to skip)

✅ *Attendance Recorded!*

📋 *Session:* @results.session_desc
👥 *Present:* @results.attendance_count
📝 *Notes:* @results.attendance_notes
🏆 *Club:* @contact.fields.club_name.value

[REAL] Your CC has been notified. Keep up the consistency — regular attendance builds stronger clubs! 💪

Send *report* to submit an activity report for this session.

📊 *Activity Report*

Club: @contact.fields.club_name.value
YF: @contact.fields.full_name.value

[REAL] This report goes to Sauramandala's programme team. It helps them understand what is working, send you better resources, and support struggling clubs.

*What activity did your club do?*

1 - Icebreaker / introductions
2 - Group discussion
3 - Creative (art, drama, music)
4 - Outdoor / physical
5 - Community service / action

*How did the session go overall?*

1 - 😰 Very challenging
2 - 😕 Struggled a bit
3 - 😐 It was okay
4 - 😊 Went well
5 - 🌟 Excellent!

*What was one thing that worked well?*

(This goes directly to your programme team — be honest and specific)

*What was one challenge or difficulty?*

(e.g. "Low turnout", "Topic was too complex", "Venue issue")

*Do you need any support from your Centre Coordinator?*

1 - Yes, please contact me
2 - No, all good

✅ *Report Submitted!*

📊 *Activity:* @results.report_activity
⭐ *Rating:* @results.report_rating
💚 *What worked:* @results.report_win
⚠️ *Challenge:* @results.report_challenge
🆘 *Support needed:* @results.report_support_needed

[REAL] Your CC and the programme team have received this. If you requested support, expect a call within 24 hours.

Keep going — you are building something important. 🌱
